messages.author: 8c8f0ca54c4a2459
messages.subject: And the winner is...Vince Buffalo!
parts:
Hey all,

Congrats to Vince Buffalo, who wins D-RUG's "Most Helpful Listserv Person" award, for responding to the most D-RUG help requests this academic year.  He edged out David J. Harris by a single response.

Vince, get in touch with me to collect your prize - your choice of a T-shirt of a Flying R Monkey.

Also, to all: If you haven't yet filled out the 5-minute survey about how to make D-RUG more useful, please do so here - http://goo.gl/4Q6jp

Cheers,

Noam

messages.subject: Re: [D-RUG]: And the winner is...Vince Buffalo!
parts:
Woohoo, thanks Noam!

I'm glad I was able to offer help, and look forward to continuing to do so. 

I should be able to start going to the meetings next quarter too. 

Vince
